name: Battle

components.pose: She stands braced against the storm with her frost-crystal staff raised in one hand and the other palm held out, her cloak whipping, an icy, unshakable gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.jewelry: a white-silver gorget set with a {{GEM}} crystal, frost-etched bracers
components.legs_feet: armoured boots lined with white fur
components.effects: A wall of ice erupts in front of her, shards and swirling snow whipping around her, frost racing outward across the ground in {{MAGIC}} light.

notes: BATTLE: the sister in class-aligned war gear commanding her element on a battlefield of her homeland. Reuses her signature weapon.
